answer: Use a delayed uniqueness challenge pool. Each new identity must post a fixed 10-minute CPU escrow, returned only after it solves a fresh task derived from the system's kernel and completes one interaction; duplicates fail and forfeit the escrow. Registration attempts feed a spiral of varied challenges, so copying one solution does not amortize across clones. A sparrow-level clone pays that full escrow plus challenge compute, so marginal clone EV is strictly negative.
